content.value_statement: Design teams often need starter tokens from an existing public site before rebuilding a UI. This skill guides extraction, review, and token file generation for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Prompts the agent to confirm a public target URL before extraction.
Runs the extract-design-system CLI to collect public website design primitives.
Summarizes normalized colors, fonts, spacing, radius, and shadows.
Generates or explains token files such as tokens.json and tokens.css.
Supports extraction-only and token regeneration workflows.
limitations: It does not produce a complete component library.
Generated tokens are starter assets and require human review.
Single-page or dynamic sites may produce incomplete coverage.
Extraction requires external CLI commands and local Chromium when needed.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap Tokens From A Public Site
use_cases.description: Create starter color, font, spacing, radius, and shadow tokens from a public website.

use_cases.title: Audit A Legacy Website Style
use_cases.description: Summarize the visible design primitives before planning a frontend rebuild.

use_cases.title: Share A Design Primitive Summary
use_cases.description: Produce a concise design token summary for review before implementation work begins.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Basic Website Tokens
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner extraction from one public URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Use extract-design-system on this public URL: https://example.com. Generate starter token files and summarize the extracted primitives.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Without Starter Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze https://example.com with extraction only. Summarize colors, fonts, spacing, radius, and shadows without generating starter files.

prompt_templates.title: Regenerate Existing Token Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Existing normalized output is already present
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the existing normalized extraction output to regenerate starter token files. Explain each generated artifact and do not modify app code.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Token Adoption Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract tokens from https://example.com, review the normalized output, then propose a safe adoption plan. Ask before editing existing styles.

output_examples.input: Extract tokens from a public marketing site and create starter files.
output: Confirmed the target is public and reachable.
Created raw and normalized extraction artifacts.
Generated starter token files with color, font, spacing, radius, and shadow summaries.

output_examples.input: Analyze a site without generating starter files.
output_examples.output: Produced an extraction summary with likely primary colors, detected fonts, and available spacing or shadow scales.

output_examples.input: Regenerate token files from an existing normalized extraction.
output_examples.output: Regenerated the starter token assets and explained where to review token data and CSS variables.

best_practices: Use public URLs and verify permission to analyze the site.
Review normalized output before importing tokens into an application.
Ask for confirmation before modifying existing app code or style configuration.
anti_patterns: Treating one page as a full design system.
Importing generated tokens without reviewing colors, fonts, and spacing.
Running extraction against private, authenticated, or sensitive pages.

faq.question: Does this skill build a component library?
faq.answer: No. It extracts starter design primitives and token files, not full components.

faq.question: Will it overwrite my app styles?
faq.answer: It should not modify existing app code or styles without explicit confirmation.

faq.question: What files can it produce?
faq.answer: It can produce raw extraction data, normalized data, token data, and CSS variable starter files.

faq.question: Does extraction require a browser dependency?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow may install Chromium through Playwright when it is missing locally.

faq.question: Can it analyze private or authenticated pages?
faq.answer: No. The skill is intended for public and reachable website URLs only.

faq.question: How accurate are the generated tokens?
faq.answer: They are useful starting points. Review them before treating them as project standards.
